# Analytical approaches of the 1000FARMS team

> Tested R workflows for analysing tricot, on-farm ranking and consumer concept data, each with the reasoning behind the method, its alternatives and its limits.

Read SKILL.md before analysing data. It routes each question to a use case and decision record.

## Core files

- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/analysis-workflows/main/SKILL.md): question routing, procedure and boundaries
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/analysis-workflows/main/AGENTS.md): rules for AI agents
- [decisions/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/analysis-workflows/main/decisions/README.md): methodological decision records
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/analysis-workflows/main/README.md): overview and use-case table

## Related

- [tricot-knowledge-base](https://github.com/AgrDataSci/tricot-knowledge-base): the evidence base on tricot and product testing
